subject: [PATCH v2] squashfs: avoid thundering-herd cache wakeups

2026-08-09.patch_summary: This patch modifies the squashfs cache handling to avoid 'thundering herd' wakeups, which occur when multiple tasks are woken up simultaneously due to a single event. The patch makes waits exclusive and enqueues them while holding the cache lock, ensuring that a concurrent lookup either sees the waiter queued or the waiter sees the block published. This change reduces CPU usage spikes caused by frequent wakeups and improves system performance.

reviews.author: Usama Arif (author)
reviews.summary: Author acknowledged that the wake_up_all() call in squashfs_cache_put() needs to be removed, agreed to restructure in v2.
